display.purpose: Section takeover titles and the hero name.

label.purpose: Dates, tags, counters, hints. Never sentences.

pixel.purpose: Game mode and the brand mark only.

shadows.name: bench
shadows.purpose: Cards, nav pill and panels (light). Night: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .3), 0 12px 32px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / .6).

motion.name: ease-ui
motion.purpose: UI state changes, nav glow, sheet.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: 1px hover lift on buttons and chips.

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card{background:var(--surface,#1b1528);border:1px solid var(--line,#2f2645);border-radius:14px;padding:22px;color:var(--ink,#eee9f7);font-family:'Space Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.3),0 12px 32px -16px rgb(0 0 0/.6)}.ds-card small{font:400 12.5px 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;color:var(--ink-3,#9088a3)}.ds-card h3{margin:8px 0 4px;font-size:21px}.ds-card p{margin:0;color:var(--ink-2,#c3bad4)}

narrative.overview: The site is an engineer's workbench after hours: a violet task light over blueprints, labelled parts and a project half-assembled. Precise and tactile.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, with a fully supported light paper theme.
Space Grotesk carries the voice; IBM Plex Mono for every label.
Scroll-driven, slow motion, off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Task-Light Rule
rules.body: Violet marks what to look at or touch.

rules.name: The Two-Theme Rule
rules.body: No colour literal in a component.

rules.name: The Parts-Label Rule
rules.body: Dates, counts, tags, units and hints in mono; sentences never.

rules.name: The One-Shadow Rule
rules.body: One shadow token; hover is a 1px lift plus a violet border.

dos: Do resolve every colour through a token that has both a light and a night value.
Do set dates, tags, counts and hints in IBM Plex Mono.
Do show the real artefact wherever a claim about a build is made.
Do give every animation a static reduced-motion state.
Do keep hover feedback to a 1px lift and a violet border.
donts: Don't put thick coloured stripes on one side of cards.
Don't animate width, height, padding or margin.
Don't let a takeover title leave a viewport empty for long.
Don't use the same emoji or icon tile on every card in a grid.
Don't use magenta, cyan or gold for text in professional mode.
